verdict.rationale: Penpot documents its own outbound webhooks, which fire HTTP calls to other applications when events occur, such as a file being created or updated or a comment being added. That gives a basic event-triggered action, but there is no in-product rule engine, and the integration guide says the webhook system has no dedicated documentation yet. Missing for 10: a user-definable rule/condition engine, configurable in-product actions beyond outbound calls, a documented list of event types and filtering, webhook documentation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Outbound webhooks are event calls from Penpot to other applications. They notify that some event occurred, e.g. a file has been created or updated, a comment has been added, etc.
The guide also notes the webhook system has no dedicated documentation yet.
